status_definitions.USABLE: Fresh independently qualified future zones for target under stated source sample; no wholemarket census implied

status_definitions.UNUSABLE: Actual target response checked, zones fail applicable identity/unit/time/model/pricebasis requirements
status_definitions.UNSUPPORTED_CONFIRMED: Explicit current provider support decision for independently mapped instrument, with precise source/scope evidence; never inferred from absence in a bounded page
status_definitions.NOT_CHECKED: No admitted applicable current target evidence, including no accountlist/key/mapping; not unsupported

future_only_exclusions: Price levels without a future-position/model basis
clock_rule: Metadata generation timestamp never substitutes for source/event/base-state/calc clocks; none supplied for current target rows
